title_sq: Hotel ne shitje ne afersi te qendres ne rrugen Siri Kodra ne Tirane (ID 4171292)
description_sq:
Ne afersi te qendres ne rrugen Siri Kodra, shitet hotel, siperfaqa 320 m², 4 kate, 6 dhoma, nje lokal ne katin perdhe.
Hoteli eshte i mire investuar me dhoma komode, kondicioner ne cdo dhome, parket, wi-fi, lokali eshte funksional dhe te ofron rehati dhe qetesi vetem pak metra larg zhurmes se qendres.
Cmimi 650 000 Euro
Aktualisht i dhene me qera me kontrate 5 vjecare deri ne 2031, ne vleren 2200 euro.
title_en: Hotel for sale near the center on Siri Kodra street in Tirana (ID 4171292)
description_en: Near the center on Siri Kodra street, hotel for sale, surface area 320 m², 4 floors, 6 rooms, a bar on the ground floor. The hotel is well invested with comfortable rooms, air conditioning in every room, parquet, wi-fi, the bar is functional and offers comfort and peace just a few meters away from the noise of the center. Price 650,000 Euros Currently leased with a 5-year contract until 2031, worth 2200 Euros.
